findings.headline: Japan executed RECORD yen intervention — likely funded by selling US Treasuries (MoF data inference)
findings.summary: Bloomberg (Sep 6) and Japan Times (Sep 7): Japan likely sold a portion of its foreign securities holdings, including US Treasuries, to fund a RECORD yen intervention. Yen rallied sharply with USD/JPY falling from near 160 to under 156 last week. First direct evidence of official-sector UST selling this cycle — a new channel feeding global bond stress.

findings.headline: Yen at one-month high on intervention talk + BOJ rate-bet repricing; hawkish-BOJ vs Fed-hike clash opens the week
findings.summary: Yen jumped >1% Thursday to a one-month high as traders weighed further intervention and BOJ rate-hike repricing. FXStreet Sep 7: USD/JPY subdued at week-open as 'hawkish BoJ, Fed bets clash'. Brokerage research: markets now pricing BOJ hikes. FX pressure on Japan eased near-term, but the intervention-funding mechanism (asset sales) is the structural worry.

findings.headline: Iran escalates rhetoric: 'more intense' / 'more painful response' warned; Ghalibaf: 'the era of proportionate responses has come to an end'
findings.summary: Iranian parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf: 'The Americans must have understood that the era of proportionate responses has come to an end.' Tehran warns of a stronger response to further US strikes as CENTCOM enforces its maritime blockade. Coercion signaling ahead of the restricted-zone implementation — escalation language, not de-escalation.

findings.headline: August NFP blowout sends Fed HIKE odds to 55-62%; DXY back above 99; CPI verdict is the decision trigger
findings.summary: Strong August nonfarm payrolls re-reversed Fed pricing UP: hike odds ~62% (StockwireX Sep 7), DXY >99.00. FXEmpire: strong jobs 'increased the risk of a September hike'. The Waller de-escalation tick from 00:32Z is dead. Two central banks now tightening into a supply shock (oil ~$96, food red). September FOMC Sep 15-16; CPI first.

findings.headline: ECB set to hike Sep 10 (25bp expected) with eurozone inflation at 3-year high >3%; Simkus: 'this September hike is not going to be enough'; Makhlouf uneasy
findings.source: Echo scan 06:30 IST observables (ECB officials) / Xinhua fiscal-risk watch
findings.summary: ECB officials signal more tightening needed: Simkus says the September hike won't be enough; Makhlouf (Ireland) 'uneasy' at >3% inflation, urges readiness for further rises. ECB hike lands Sep 10 — two days before US CPI, into a French-bond flashpoint and 3-year-high EU gas.

findings.headline: BOJ hawkish repricing confirmed: markets price September hike (Sep 18 meeting), driving yen rally and JGB pressure
findings.summary: Yen's sharp weekly rally tied to BOJ rate-hike repricing; hawkish BOJ vs Fed bets divergence the week's FX axis. September synchronized-tightening window now fully loaded: ECB Sep 10, FOMC Sep 15-16, BOJ Sep 18.

findings.headline: Scope Ratings: 'a bond crisis is when central banks step in' — backstop-expectations language enters mainstream commentary
findings.summary: Scope Ratings frames the live question as WHEN central banks intervene in a bond crisis, not whether. Normalization of central-bank-backstop assumptions during a sovereign-bond selloff is itself a stress precursor — markets are pre-positioning for intervention.

findings.headline: US struck 3 Iranian oil tankers after warships were targeted with ballistic missiles; CENTCOM maritime blockade of Iran active
findings.source: PBS NewsHour (AP) / Al Jazeera / News24 (F-35A patrols)
findings.summary: US military hit 3 Iranian oil tankers after saying navy ships were targeted with ballistic missiles. CENTCOM enforcing a maritime blockade of Iran; F-35A stealth patrols over regional waters. Tanker war institutionalized: state-on-state strikes on energy logistics are now routine operations.

findings.headline: Iran declares restricted/exclusion maritime zone OUTSIDE Strait of Hormuz for selected vessels — implementation 'within days'
findings.source: India Today / Iran top security official via echo scan
findings.summary: Iran said it will declare an exclusion zone outside the Strait of Hormuz for selected vessels; top security official confirmed a 'restricted' maritime zone will be declared within days. Second chokepoint-restriction rung: the world's most important oil artery now operates under announced Iranian exclusion rules amid active US-Iran exchange.

findings.headline: US declares NATIONAL EMERGENCY to secure the bulk-power system (Federal Register Aug 31)
findings.source: Federal Register / Executive Office of the President
findings.summary: Presidential national emergency declared to secure the US bulk-power (electric grid) system, published Aug 31 — one week before this scan. Posture hardening on critical energy infrastructure; context finding (no direct thread mapping). Separate export-control national emergency continued Aug 14 (routine).

findings.headline: Iran struck a US UNMANNED vessel (Sep 6) — first claimed direct Iranian strike on a US vessel
findings.summary: Iran struck a US unmanned surface vessel — the first claimed direct Iranian strike on a US-flagged vessel of the war. Crossed the vessel-type threshold: US crewed-ship retaliation now one incident away. Verified in this morning's 04:30Z breaking scan; included for thread completeness.

findings.headline: Israel-Lebanon second front active: Israeli strikes killed 4 in Lebanon
findings.summary: Second front confirmed active — Israeli strikes in Lebanon killed 4. Regional war breadth expanding beyond the US-Iran naval theater; multi-front dynamics raise broadening risk (Gulf states, Levant).

findings.headline: US envoys Witkoff/Kushner met Putin, now in Kyiv with 'more effective' peace proposals
findings.summary: Ukraine-theater diplomacy active. Context finding — no direct mapping to the 8 threads this cycle; monitored for energy/gas linkage to European stress.

findings.headline: Hormuz traffic down ~95%; war-risk cover canceled/repriced; 'Hormuz on a Knife-Edge' as Iran-US ceasefire unravels
findings.summary: Al Jazeera data story: 95% drop in Hormuz traffic has already redrawn global shipping. gCaptain: shipping 'pays the price as the Iran-US ceasefire unravels'; marine insurers canceled war-risk cover earlier in the conflict. The chokepoint is functionally constrained — not at risk of disruption, but disrupted.

findings.headline: Brent $96.02 (+6.27 w/w), war band $94-97; food price index red at 131.8 and deteriorating — energy pass-through hits food next

findings.summary: Brent live ~$94-97 war band (signal-board value $96.02, deteriorating). IMF Food Price Index 131.8 red/deteriorating. Energy-to-food pass-through is the next stagflation rung; oil at $96 keeps both the inflation and recession channels loaded.

findings.headline: New shipping route around Iranian restricted zone announced 'coming days'; tanker costs set to rise further
findings.summary: Iran's restricted zone + alternative routing regime takes effect within days; freight and insurance premia step up again on rerouting. Logistics cost inflation compounds the oil shock into H2 supply chains.

findings.headline: China issues 300bn yuan special treasury bonds — $54bn recapitalisation of 8 state banks/insurers, biggest financial recap push in two decades
findings.summary: China's Ministry of Finance will issue 300bn yuan in special treasury bonds to boost financial firms' capital — pumping ~$54bn into eight state banks and insurers, the biggest recapitalisation push in two decades. Announced Monday Sep 7 amid 'fears over sluggish growth'. Official intervention at this scale arrives BECAUSE stress exists.

findings.headline: Temporary price-band protections approved for overnight trading due to 'Extraordinary Market Volatility' (Federal Register 2026)
findings.source: Federal Register (91 FR 51515) / Joint Industry Plan
findings.summary: SEC-approved 27th amendment to the NMS plan establishes temporary price band protections in OVERNIGHT trading to address extraordinary volatility. Regulatory stress response to overnight-session instability — circuit-breaker architecture being extended to hours that used to be quiet. Signal: market structure is strained outside regular hours.

findings.headline: China property presale-rule upheaval targets shadow banking and local-government debt
findings.summary: Property overhaul aims at shadow banking/local debt channels (carried from 04:30Z scan basis; no fresh Sep 7 developments). Structural de-risking of property finance is itself a deflationary force for the China thread.

findings.headline: Export-control national emergency continued (Federal Register Aug 14) — routine continuation, context only
findings.summary: Annual continuation of the export-control national emergency. Context finding, no thread mapping.

findings.headline: Jakarta protests persist despite volcanic ash fallout; 760 police deployed
findings.summary: Protests continue in central Jakarta despite falling volcanic ash from Anak Krakatau; 760 officers deployed today. Indonesia unrest persists under compound stress (political + natural). Weak regional-sentiment channel for asian_contagion.

findings.headline: Global bond wildfire: US Treasuries + UK gilts at decades-high yields; 'no plan' commentary; 'next domino still mispriced'
findings.summary: Guardian: yields on USTs and gilts recently hit their highest levels for decades; 'as instability in global bond markets rises... there's no plan'. ainvest: global government-bond yields doing something not seen in decades; the next domino is mispriced. Globe & Mail: bond unease is the greatest risk for the next financial crisis. Sovereign-bond wildfire is the week's dominant stress precursor.

findings.headline: France-Italy OAT/BTP yield INVERSION; France-bund spread at debt-crisis levels; 57.5% foreign-held French debt = flight risk; Japan institutions repatriating from French assets
findings.summary: French OAT yields overtook Italian BTPs (El-Erian: 'Rome beats Paris'); France's spread over bunds hits debt-crisis levels; foreign investors hold 57.5% of French debt, raising flight risk. Seoul Economic Daily flags Japan's big institutions showing signs of REPATRIATING from French debt — direct japan_yen-to-euro_crisis transmission channel via the intervention funding.

findings.headline: BTC breaks below $80,000 ($78,649 low) on Fed hike bets; crypto-wide selloff on Iran strikes; Liquid Network federation-reserve breach (4,000 BTC ~$320M); USDT market-cap reduction
findings.source: Straits Times (Sep 7) / ainvest (Sep 5) / memeburn (Sep 5) / biggo finance (Sep 7) / Echo scan cyber note

Liquid Network 4,000 BTC federation-reserve breach (~$320M) did not move BTC price; USDT market-cap reduction noted. Crypto stress is macro-driven, not idiosyncratic — WATCH posture held.

findings.headline: China state bank/insurer shares SLIDE after $54bn injection plan — 'limited short-term impact' seen amid weak credit demand
findings.summary: Market reaction to the recap was skeptical: eight Chinese financial institutions' shares slid; funding seen having 'limited short-term impact' amid weak credit demand. Stimulus skepticism + weak credit demand = china_collapse stress-response evidence.

findings.headline: JGB stress sustained: 10Y 3.02% / 30Y 4.18%; 30Y auction = global repricing bellwether
findings.summary: Japanese government bond yields hold at cycle extremes (10Y >3%, 30Y 4.18%); the 30Y auction functions as the global repricing bellwether. Japan's banks/insurers face mark-to-market pressure as BOJ hike odds firm; intervention funding via asset sales compounds the flow.

findings.headline: Private credit funding ~$800B AI data-center debt with cover ratios <2x; BIS top-risk flags
findings.summary: Private credit is carrying ~$800B of AI data-center debt at coverage ratios below 2x; BIS flags it as top risk. Credit-quality stress in the AI buildout is the hidden domino behind the public bond selloff.
